mapper.select: SELECT ut.id, ut.user_id as userId, ut.tunnel_id as tunnelId, t.name as tunnelName, t.flow as tunnelFlow, ut.flow, ut.in_flow as inFlow, ut.out_flow as outFlow, ut.num, ut.flow_reset_time as flowResetTime, ut.exp_time as expTime, ut.speed_id as speedId, sl.name as speedLimitName, sl.speed FROM user_tunnel ut LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON ut.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN speed_limit sl ON ut.speed_id = sl.id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND (t.owner_user_id IS NULL OR t.owner_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY ut.id

SELECT f.id, f.name, f.tunnel_id as tunnelId, t.name as tunnelName, t.in_ip as inIp, f.in_port as inPort, f.remote_addr as remoteAddr, f.in_flow as inFlow, f.out_flow as outFlow, f.status, f.created_time as createdTime FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
SELECT id FROM node WHERE owner_user_id = #{userId}

SELECT n.id, n.name FROM node n WHERE n.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_tunnel ut INNER JOIN tunnel t ON t.id = ut.tunnel_id LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_node ten ON ten.tunnel_id = t.id AND (ten.status IS NULL OR ten.status = 1) WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.status = 1 AND (ut.exp_time IS NULL OR ut.exp_time > #{now}) AND t.status = 1 AND (t.owner_user_id IS NULL OR t.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AND (n.id = t.in_node_id OR n.id = t.out_node_id OR n.id = ten.node_id) ) ORDER BY n.id
SELECT id, name FROM node ORDER BY id

SELECT MIN(ut.exp_time) FROM user_tunnel ut INNER JOIN tunnel t ON t.id = ut.tunnel_id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.status = 1 AND ut.exp_time > #{now} AND t.status = 1 AND (t.owner_user_id IS NULL OR t.owner_user_id = #{userId})

SELECT t.id, 0 as userId, t.id as tunnelId, t.name as tunnelName, t.flow as tunnelFlow, 99999 as flow, 0 as inFlow, 0 as outFlow, 99999 as num, null as flowResetTime, null as expTime, null as speedId, '无限制' as speedLimitName, null as speed FROM tunnel t WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.id
